summary: Audited data_validation/data_prep.py + extract.py against DATA_SPECIFICATION.md (authority) + validation.py label sets. Fixed 4 doc-proven defects in data_prep.py: (1) _map_outcome now maps the documented made labels rim-in/board-in/bounce-in to 'made' (previously ValueError; DATA_SPECIFICATION §3.3 + validation._MADE_LABELS); (2) outcome column alias 'madeshots'->'madeshot' so the documented 'made_shot' column is recognised (§7); (3) _unit_scale no longer misreads the preposition 'in' in 'Distance_in_m' as inches — 'inch'/'(in)' kept, '_in' replaced by name.endswith('_in'), so metre headers stay x1.0 (latent unit-mixup, safe fix); (4) removed the speed/angle 'both-or-neither' raise so 'otherwise 51° vacuum fallback' (§7) applies when exactly one of Shot_Speed/Release_Angle is present. extract.py found correct vs §4 (moment indices [1]/[3]/[5], entity x/y/z at [2]/[3]/[4], 0.3048 + round(3), short-frame skip, selfcheck fixture, CLI exit codes, unit conversion once) — no code change; reported docstring ASCII-art (shot_clock at index 2) vs its own text (index 3) as an ambiguity. Verified: py_compile both files (exit 0); python -m unittest test_data_prep -> 3 pass + 4 pre-existing NameError 'prep' (undefined in test file, read-only, unchanged by my edits); python test_data_prep.py exit 0 runs zero tests (no __main__ block); python data_validation/extract.py --selfcheck exit 0; synthetic-CSV round-trips via _read_rows (made_shot alias, detailed outcomes, cm/ft/inch height scaling, speed+angle, speed-only fallback) and full main() CLI (exit 0 correct 9-col output; refuse-overwrite exit 2; missing-input exit 2; missing-column clear error). Numeric before/after probes: _map_outcome('rim-in'|'board-in'|'bounce-in') ValueError->'made'; _find_column('made_shot') ValueError->'made_shot'; _unit_scale('Distance_in_m') 0.0254->1.0 (release_in/Height_inches/Release_Height_(in) unchanged 0.0254); speed-only CSV ValueError->51° fallback v0=(4.722,5.832,0); _initial_velocity(4.57,2.27) unchanged (4.589,5.668,0) and lands y=3.05 at x=4.57; _estimate_release_height unchanged (2.274/2.5015); DEFAULT_BACKSPIN_RAD_S unchanged 14.137166941154069 (formats to 14.137167).
